Proof in the paper: X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of OVR-CuCo-MOFs NS and OV-Cu-MOFs NS are shown in Fig. 3a. Each sample displays the typical (002), (210), (004), and (110) Bragg reflections of Cu-TCPP, and the enhanced intensities of the (004) and (210) planes indicated the incorporation of cobalt dopants in the OVR-CuCo-MOF NS.
